notes: Modified cash basis city with accrual-basis enterprise funds. Governmental receipts/disbursements, transfers and balances come from the Statement of Revenues, Expenditures, and Changes in Fund Balances - Modified Cash Basis - Governmental Funds (p5, Total Governmental Funds column; added by the find_pages v8 re-trim, replacing the earlier Statement of Activities-based lines and depreciation). Fund balances equal cash (no liabilities; Balance Sheet p4 total assets 841,288 = cash 796,725 + CDs 34,599 + county treasurer cash 9,964), so beginning_cash = fund balance 9/30/2024 751,392 and ending_cash = 841,288 (p5). Roll-forward: 751,392 + 917,993 - 805,997 - 22,100 = 841,288. Transfers: p5 total column shows net (22,100) (General +8,549 and Street +28,144 in; Sales Tax 28,144, CDA 22,100 and Keno 8,549 out), recorded as transfers_out 22,100; the proprietary statement (p7) labels 22,100 'Transfers to other funds' but adds it in the change in net position and cash flows (p9) show it as an inflow, so business_type.transfers_net = +22,100. Balance sheet is the government-wide Statement of Net Position (p1). Statement of Cash Flows p8 covers Water only; p9 has Sewer, Trash and Total columns (Total used). Detail: General Fund budget schedule (p10) not recorded separately because the departmental combining statement (p14-15) is more detailed and has the same totals (608,646 / 614,180); Street (p11), Sales Tax (p12) and Community Development Agency (p13) budget schedules recorded. Keno Fund has no schedule. Read pages 1-16 of 16
